metadata.topic: Optics — Wavelength in Water and Critical Angle for Water-Air Boundary
metadata.note: Q3e (2 marks): λ_water = λ_air / n = 532 / 1.33 = 400 nm exactly. Q3f(i) (2 marks): critical angle using sin(c) = 1/n → c = arcsin(1/1.33) = 48.75°. Q3d (derivation of n = λa/λm) is open-ended — not auto-gradeable. Q3f(ii) (1 mark, text: total internal reflection) is excluded.

question.name: CSEC Phy Jan 2022 Q3e/f(i) — Wavelength in Water and Critical Angle
question.text:
A beam of green laser light of wavelength 532 nm in air travels in water. The refractive index of water is 1.33.

Part (e): Calculate the wavelength of the laser light in water. (2 marks)

Part (f)(i): Calculate the critical angle at the water-air boundary. (2 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Q3e — Wavelength in water:
Using n = λ_air / λ_water → λ_water = λ_air / n
λ_water = 532 / 1.33 = 400 nm

Q3f(i) — Critical angle:
At the critical angle, the refracted ray travels along the boundary (angle of refraction = 90°).
sin(c) = 1/n = 1/1.33 = 0.7519
c = arcsin(0.7519) = 48.75° ≈ 48.8°

steps.label:
Given: λ_air = 532 nm  |  n (water) = 1.33
Formula (e): n = λ_air / λ_water → λ_water = λ_air / n
Formula (f)(i): sin(c) = 1/n (critical angle condition: refracted ray at 90°)
Q3e — Calculate the wavelength of laser light in water. (2 marks)
Q3f(i) — Calculate the critical angle at the water-air boundary. (2 marks)

fields.label: Wavelength of laser light in water λ_water = _____ nm

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: λ_water = λ_air ÷ n = 532 ÷ 1.33 = 400 nm. Divide the air wavelength by the refractive index.
error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Use n = λ_air / λ_water, rearranged to λ_water = λ_air / n = 532 / 1.33.
At the critical angle, the refracted ray travels along the surface (90°). By Snell's Law: n × sin(c) = 1 × sin(90°) = 1, so sin(c) = 1/n = 1/1.33.

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: c = arcsin(1/1.33) = arcsin(0.7519) ≈ 48.8°. Use the inverse sine (sin⁻¹) function on your calculator.
